name: Regrid
shortDescription: Nationwide parcel boundaries and owner fields, sold by county or state.
longDescription: Regrid sells standardized US parcel geometry and assessment fields. The data store prices files by county or state, and the docs also point to API and property-app plans. There is no single monthly price.
pricingNotes: County and state files are priced in the data store. Nationwide licenses are quoted. No single monthly price.
bestFor: Buying parcel boundaries and owner fields for a county or state
notIdealFor: Someone who wants one click-through map subscription with a single monthly price
strength: Regrid sells parcel boundaries and owner fields by county or state, so there is no single monthly price.
weakness: A data file or license is a different product from a map you click through for one parcel.
